classification.formal_source: Existing catalog provenance retained locally; no private document or reference is included.
classification.runtime_authority: Current unchanged hex.bin decoded with the existing portable Variant decoder; round-trip bytes matched.
classification.presentation_choice: Small floating wisp, faint exact-radius halo, last-quarter fade and 0.35s pickup spark are new visual choices only.

normal_first_floor_reachability.condition: Select G10 before row5 and defeat its elite while at least one ordinary enemy remains. The original elite branch can produce a real, live pickup without money, debug kills or a changed threshold. This is a code/route proof, not a recorded playthrough.
normal_first_floor_reachability.boundary: If the last enemy is killed, original end_room clears souls. The overlay does not extend pickups into safe rooms.

original_mechanics_unchanged: actor-clock spawn interval and speed buff
missing_consumer: Current Fengli presentation and environment contain no soul consumer. Source generation and pickup already exist; this patch adds visibility and actual-pickup feedback, not new G10 combat rules.
